stories.title: In centinaia protestano contro Netanyahu all’Onu: “Basta armi a Israele”. Arrestata Susan Sarandon

en.title: Hundreds protest against Netanyahu at UN: "Stop arms to Israel". Susan Sarandon arrested
en.summary: Hundreds gathered at the UN in a demonstration organized by Jewish Voice for Peace opposing Netanyahu, resulting in dozens of arrests. The city was secured by Mayor Mamdani.

stories.title: Aula semi vuota all’Onu mentre Netanyahu parla: molte delegazioni lasciano l'Assemblea

en.title: Semi-empty hall at UN while Netanyahu speaks: many delegations leave the Assembly
en.summary: Multiple diplomats walked out of the UN assembly in New York with some booing as Netanyahu addressed the gathering. Netanyahu responded with sharp criticism of the protest.

stories.title: Proteste Pro-Pal, il momento in cui Susan Sarandon viene fermata dalla polizia

en.title: Pro-Palestinian protests, the moment Susan Sarandon is stopped by police
en.summary: Actress Susan Sarandon was detained by police while participating in demonstrations near UN headquarters against Netanyahu's presence.

stories.title: Proteste contro Netanyahu all'Onu, arrestata Susan Sarandon

en.title: Protests against Netanyahu at UN, Susan Sarandon arrested
en.summary: Demonstrations took place around UN headquarters with initial arrests made during protests against Netanyahu.

stories.title: Trump riceve Xi in pompa magna. Il leader cinese: “Evitiamo la trappola di Tucidide”

en.title: Trump receives Xi with great ceremony. Chinese leader: "Let us avoid the Thucydides trap"
en.summary: The U.S. president emphasized a strong friendship with his Chinese counterpart, while Xi maintained a more measured approach and raised concerns about Chinese companies' access to American markets.

stories.title: Proteste per Netanyahu all’Onu, arrestata Susan Sarandon

en.title: Protests against Netanyahu at the UN, Susan Sarandon arrested
en.summary: Demonstrations took place around the UN headquarters, with several people detained during the protests.

stories.title: Trump: "Io e Xi grandi amici". Il leader cinese: "Su Iran si torni al memorandum di giugno"

en.title: Trump: "Xi and I are great friends". Chinese leader: "On Iran, return to the June memorandum"
en.summary: During a White House summit, Xi announced a surprise new trade agreement. Discussions focused on economic truce, artificial intelligence, Taiwan's independence concerns, Iran nuclear matters, and related issues.

stories.title: Scuola, ecco il decreto: tetto a stranieri nelle classi prime, multe fino a 1000 euro per il burqa

en.title: School, here is the decree: cap on foreign students in first-year classes, fines up to 1000 euros for burqa
en.summary: A decree establishes limits on foreign students in initial classes and penalties for certain religious garments, while providing funds for language support. Technical and professional institutes will be renamed lyceums.

stories.title: Riccardo Bossi arrestato, deve scontare 5 anni e 9 mesi. Il fratello Renzo: “Paga le sue scelte”

en.title: Riccardo Bossi arrested, must serve 5 years and 9 months. Brother Renzo: "He pays for his choices"
en.summary: Riccardo Bossi, son of a former senator, was arrested to serve a combined sentence for embezzlement, fraud, and false citizenship income declarations.

stories.title: Assemblea Onu, proteste pro-Pal contro Netanyahu. Diplomatici lasciano aula prima del suo discorso

en.title: UN Assembly, pro-Palestine protests against Netanyahu. Diplomats leave hall before his speech
en.summary: Diplomats walked out during Netanyahu's UN address amid pro-Palestine demonstrations. Netanyahu criticized those who left, while Xi and Abu Mazen made separate statements on peace and visa denial.

stories.title: Scuola, ok al decreto. Meloni: “Stop burqa e niqab”. Tetto del 30% di stranieri nelle classi

en.title: School, decree approved. Meloni: "Stop burqa and niqab". 30% cap on foreign students in classes
en.summary: Italy approved education measures including mandatory free Italian courses for foreign parents with language barriers and a cap on foreign students, with sanctions for non-compliance.

stories.title: Arrestato Riccardo Bossi. Truffa sul reddito di cittadinanza e maltrattamenti alla madre: 5 anni e 9 mesi

en.title: Riccardo Bossi arrested. Citizenship income fraud and mistreatment of mother: 5 years and 9 months
en.summary: Riccardo Bossi was arrested for convictions involving citizenship income fraud and mistreatment, covering offenses from 2011 and 2020.

stories.title: All’Ospedale di Niguarda una “Casa” per le famiglie dei bimbi in pediatria

en.title: A "House" for families of children in pediatrics at Niguarda Hospital
en.summary: A new 600-square-meter facility was inaugurated in the pediatrics department at Niguarda Hospital in Milan, expanding Casa Ronald McDonald Italia Ets' presence within the hospital.

stories.title: Hitachi Rail lancia il primo intercity elettrico a batteria. Trenitalia ne ha ordinati sei

en.title: Hitachi Rail launches first battery-electric intercity train. Trenitalia has ordered six
en.summary: Hitachi Rail introduced its first battery-electric intercity train, manufactured in Pistoia and Naples facilities. The train operates on both electrified lines and in battery mode with 100 kilometers of range on non-electrified routes, with Trenitalia placing an order for six units.

stories.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, oltre mille eventi all’insegna della biodiversità

en.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, over one thousand events celebrating biodiversity
en.summary: The Terra Madre Salone del Gusto event is organizing more than one thousand events focused on biodiversity, following a coordination meeting held in Pollenzo the previous year.

stories.title: Da Nestlé a Nespresso a Redion, così Bocconi fa lavorare (e laureare) detenuti

en.title: From Nestlé to Nespresso to Redion, how Bocconi works with (and graduates) prisoners
en.summary: Bocconi University's prison project provides employment and educational opportunities for incarcerated individuals through partnerships with major companies including Nestlé, Nespresso, and Redion.

stories.title: Advanced control solutions acquisisce Ksenia Security e Dea Security

en.title: Advanced control solutions acquires Ksenia Security and Dea Security
en.summary: Advanced control solutions, controlled by Investindustrial, has completed agreements to acquire Ksenia Security and Dea Security, two Italian companies, as part of consolidating Italian-made security capabilities.
